verdict.rationale: Lithic documents API versioning via the `api-version` header (lithic-docs-7/21) and provides a migration guide showing backward-compatible transition from legacy webhooks to the Events API with shared schemas/HMAC headers (lithic-docs-23), evidencing a real but narrow deprecation/migration practice. However, there's no general, product-wide documented deprecation policy (e.g., sunset timelines, changelog, versioning cadence) beyond this one example. Missing for 10: a comprehensive deprecation policy document, explicit version sunset dates, and broader changelog/versioning governance beyond the single webhook migration example.
